column5: appleApiKeyId is an unset local with no CLI option, so non-interactive API-key creation exits at its required-value check.
The missing appleApiKeyId option leaves the local undefined and makes non-interactive API-key creation fail unconditionally.
Certificate, key, and Apple app-specific passwords all use text prompts, covering G4’s credential prompts and G37’s Apple password prompt.
The Apple app-specific password uses a text prompt, an exposure described by both G4 and G37.
The certificate password and Android key password use unmasked text prompts, matching G4.
